definitions.explanation: The act of expecting or anticipating something to happen.

examples.japanese: {予期|よき}しない{事態|じたい}が{起|お}こった。
{予期|よき}していた{通|とお}りの{結果|けっか}だった。
examples.notes: 予期していた通り = as expected

examples.japanese: {予期|よき}せぬ{出来事|できごと}に{驚|おどろ}いた。
examples.english: I was surprised by an unforeseen event.

notes:
USAGE: {予期|よき} is often used with する to form a verb, and commonly appears in negative forms like {予期|よき}しない (unexpected) or {予期|よき}せぬ (unforeseen).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{予期|よき}する (to expect, anticipate)
・{予期|よき}しない (unexpected)
・{予期|よき}せぬ (unforeseen - literary)
・{予期|よき}に{反|はん}して (contrary to expectations)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{予想|よそう} - expectation, prediction
・{予測|よそく} - forecast, prediction
・{期待|きたい} - expectation, hope
